caption: The drawing features a square textile design placed centrally on a lightly speckled beige or off-white background. The textile pattern is composed of a repeating geometric motif in dark blue and pale light blue or white. The pattern is symmetric and consists of various rectangular, square, and grid-like shapes, as well as intersecting lines that create the appearance of concentric squares and segmented bands radiating from the center. The overall arrangement shows both horizontal and vertical symmetry. There are small rust-colored marks scattered unevenly on the background around the textile sample. At the bottom left of the image, the text "A3168 - A" is written in small print, and "Ruth M. Barnes." is written in the bottom right corner.
